opening.argument: The video presents interactive tech support scam advertisements as a problem affecting computer users. Its title identifies the subject as “The Rise of the Interactive Tech Support Scam Ads,” while the description warns that users may panic, call an advertised number, and be sold products and services they do not need. The support-style page is shown as an example of that mechanism: it claims pop-up ads are enabled, offers help disabling them, and instructs viewers to call the displayed number. That demonstration is framed as reporting or explanation of a scam tactic. The available evidence does not establish that the video itself solicits viewers to buy support.
